q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_shares_1 low) — together with the reified sk_low_1 state at 13-14 — flattens the comparative 'lower' into the positive property, which the comparatives rule explicitly says a comparative does not entail.
(Measure sk_edge_1 decrease 7 cent) invents the scale symbol 'decrease', which no word in the sentence supplies; the stated dimension is the adjective 'lower'.
(Before sk_edge_1 sk_end_1) asserts a temporal ordering that no temporal word licenses — the infinitive 'to end at $28.12' is not a past perfect, a temporal clause or a before/after adjunct.
(Ongoing sk_edge_1) has no licensed progressive marker — the participle of a 'with'-absolute is none of the four markers the instruction set enumerates.
(Measure sk_end_1 price 28.12 dollar) puts a price on the ending event rather than on the shares, where Measure's entity slot belongs (only 'duration' is defined on an event).
The name symbol 'nyse' is an acronym, not the one opaque symbol built from the whole name that the multi-word-name rule requires.

q2_gaps: Absolute 'with NP V-ing' adjunct ('with GE shares edging 7 cents lower'): the 'with'-phrase rules cover only comitative CoAgent and Instrument NPs, so the clause is asserted at top level with no relation at all to the matrix reacting event.
Differential comparative with an implicit standard ('edging 7 cents lower'): MoreBy requires an explicit 'than Y' to fill its second argument.
Result infinitive ('to end at $28.12' = and so ended): only purpose infinitives (To / InOrderTo) are covered, and result-vs-purpose is not distinguished.
Extent / downtoner adverb on an event ('reacted little'): there is no encoding beyond a plain Manner filler, which loses its near-negative force.
Episodic bare-plural subject ('Investors reacted …'): bare plurals are routed to generic rules, with no stated route for a bare plural naming specific participants in a one-off past event.
notes: 'GE shares' correctly keeps the proper-noun modifier out of a fused compound, and the price/dollar measure follows the scale and unit conventions. The decrease-measure and the low resultative also double-encode the same 7-cent fall in two incompatible ways.
